preconditions.description: Attacker must have MINTER_ROLE or DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to grant themselves MINTER_ROLE

exploit_hint: 1. Acquire MINTER_ROLE by either being the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder or having DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE grant you MINTER_ROLE via grantRole(). 2. Call mint(attacker_address, large_amount) to mint unlimited tokens to your address. 3. Swap the minted tokens for ETH/BNB through the UniswapV2 pair (uniswapV2Pair) using swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(). This dilutes token value and extracts value from liquidity providers.
